build_engine_subclass: build a subclass of AbstractEngine that implements build_model and build_dataset methods
implement_build_model: implement the build_model abstract method to return a model and optimizer tuple
implement_build_dataset: implement the build_dataset abstract method to return a dataset and metadata tuple
resume_training_from_ckpt: resume training from a checkpoint directory using the resume_from_ckpt utility function
initialize_abstract_engine: initialize an AbstractEngine subclass with local_rank, world_size, and a DictConfig
